title: SpaceX stock down again, shaving off some IPO gains; confirms debt offering
title_zh: SpaceX 股价再次下跌，削减了部分 IPO 收益；确认发债
summary: SpaceX stock fell again on Monday, now poised for three straight down days after a massive run-up following its IPO earlier this month. SpaceX also confirmed its first-ever bond issuance in a filing.
summary_zh: SpaceX 股价周一再次下跌，继本月初首次公开募股后大幅上涨后，目前已连续三天下跌。 SpaceX还在一份文件中确认了其首次债券发行。

title: Chevron (CVX) Signs 20 Year Microsoft Deal To Power Texas AI Data Center
title_zh: 雪佛龙 (CVX) 与微软签署 20 年协议，为德克萨斯州人工智能数据中心提供电力
summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) has entered a 20 year agreement to supply natural gas power to a major Microsoft AI data center in West Texas. The project, known as Project Kilby, involves Chevron, Microsoft and energy infrastructure firm Joulent.
summary_zh: 雪佛龙（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CVX）已签订一项为期 20 年的协议，为西德克萨斯州的一个主要微软人工智能数据中心提供天然气电力。该项目被称为“基尔比计划”，涉及雪佛龙、微软和能源基础设施公司 Joulent。

title: Fed hawkishness and stretched valuations offset Iran deal relief, Deutsche Bank says
title_zh: 德意志银行表示，美联储的鹰派态度和估值过高抵消了伊朗协议的缓解
summary: Despite the interim US-Iran deal and a considerable fall in oil prices, risk assets have barely moved, with the S&P 500 still beneath its record high from early June and credit spreads widening. The puzzle reflects four competing forces, Deutsche Bank analyst Henry Allen argues.
summary_zh: 尽管美伊达成临时协议且油价大幅下跌，但风险资产几乎没有变动，标准普尔 500 指数仍低于 6 月初的历史高位，信贷利差扩大。德意志银行分析师亨利·艾伦认为，这个谜题反映了四种相互竞争的力量。

title: Goldman cuts U.S. recession risk to 15% after Iran deal
title_zh: 伊朗协议达成后高盛将美国经济衰退风险下调至15%
summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs has cut its 12-month U.S. recession probability to 15% following the U.S.-Iran agreement, with chief economist Jan Hatzius citing reduced downside risks to the economic outlook and an improvement in underlying labor market resilience.
summary_zh: Investing.com——在美伊协议达成后，高盛将美国 12 个月经济衰退概率下调至 15%，首席经济学家 Jan Hatzius 表示，经济前景下行风险降低，劳动力市场潜在弹性有所改善。

title_zh: 由于交易员评估美伊协议进展并等待关键通胀报告，股市开盘前下跌
